title: Protocol IEC 60870-5-104 - added IEC-60870-5-7 dissection
description:
IEC-60870-5-7 Security extensions to IEC 60870-5-104 protocols (applying IEC 62351). Now dissector packet-iec104.c can dissects on port 19998 and can use TLS layers. New packets are added.

This merge request revoke the previous !2862

notes.body:
The following should be done before this can even be looked at:

 1. Rebase your branch against master, see [Fixing Merge Errors](https://gitlab.com/wireshark/wireshark/-/wikis/Development/SubmittingPatches#fixing-merge-errors).
 1. Amend your change to remove the spurious whitespace change to packet-mysql.
 1. Squash your multiple commits to one commit, with a message that conforms to our guidelines.  See the bottom of the [Quickstart](https://gitlab.com/wireshark/wireshark/-/wikis/Development/SubmittingPatches#quickstart) guide.
 1. Then push the changes again.
